messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] piFun for distance sampling type data?
parts:
Hi Andy;
Sorry - I was too brief. We also want to include removal (by time interval) to get at the availability issue. Your paper in AUK used this method with Bayesian HM approach - we would like to use unmarked because we wish to do simulations in R to plan the survey.
Amundson, C. L., J. A. Royle, and C. M. Handel. 2014. A hierarchical model combining distance sampling and time removal to estimate detection probability during avian point counts. The Auk 131:476-494. Eric
